description: Na₄Fe₃AlO₈ is beta beryllia-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with six FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with six FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with six FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.40 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with six FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.37 Å. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (1.91 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (1.91 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-1.92 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.78 Å) and two longer (1.79 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom to form distorted ONa₂AlFe tetrahedra that share corners with eight ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra and corners with four ONa₂AlFe trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra that share corners with eight ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra and corners with four ONa₂AlFe trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂AlFe tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form corner-sharing ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂AlFe trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂AlFe trigonal pyramids.
